method: Built-in image_gen redraw and edits; final generator file copied unchanged
prompt:
Empty-state illustration, redraw of the first attached image, keeping its exact drawing style, colours and wok design: thick dark-forest outline, glossy fills with soft highlights, chunky friendly proportions, the same charcoal wok with a wooden handle as the second reference.
Subject: an empty, clean, cold wok resting on a switched-off single-burner kompor. Nothing else in the scene.
Wok: sits squarely on the burner, tilted slightly toward the viewer so its clean, glossy, empty inner bowl is clearly visible. No food, no oil, no steam.
Wooden spatula (sutil): rests inside the wok, its blade lying on the inner bottom and its handle leaning on the rim and pointing up and to the right. It doesn't float across the top.
Kompor: cream #FFF7E9 with a forest #163D2E trim and base, and the cream sprout emblem on its front panel. Keep the cream sprout on the small forest oval badge as in Image 1.
Knob: its single, large, round forest knob has one clear thick cream indicator line pointing straight up to a small cream dot on the panel, the universal off position. Put the small cream dot on a small forest backing directly above the knob, so the dot is visible against the cream panel. Indicator and dot vertically aligned. No flame, no blue fire, no heat lines, no glow on the burner.
No extras: no rag, no towel, no other objects.
Composition: front three-quarter view. The kompor and wok form one compact group, perfectly centred horizontally and vertically, filling about 75 percent of the canvas width, so it reads at 48 px. The wok's handle and the spatula handle must not stick out past the group's balanced silhouette. Calm and tidy, nothing moving, no motion marks, no sparkles, no characters.
Margins and exclusions: even margin of at least 10 percent on every side, with no part touching or near the canvas edge. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Check before saving: The group's centre sits at the canvas centre (no right-hand bulge). The knob's line visibly points up to the dot. The spatula lies in the wok. At 48 px it reads as a wok on a stove. Next to spot-wok.png it's clearly the same wok, off duty.
Output one individual 1254x1254 PNG with REAL alpha transparency. Background entirely transparent. The complete group including both short wooden handles must fit between x=157 and x=1097, and between y=157 and y=1097. Bounding box centred on (627,627), not bottom-heavy. Keep the wok handle short at left and the resting spatula short at right for balanced silhouette. Reference 1 is the redraw target; reference 2 is the wok design/style reference only, do not copy its food or steam.
